thesis_defense_background_paragraph_1: My thesis defense took place on the 23rd of September 2024 at the ICube UMR 7357 laboratory in Illkirch-Graffenstaden, France. It is titled Hierarchical Multi-Scale Structures for Histological Image Analysis, directed by Pr Cédric WEMMERT and Pr Benoît NAEGEL and prepared at the ICube UMR 7357 laboratory of the University of Strasbourg.
thesis_defense_jury_1: Prof Nicolas PASSAT, Professor, University of Reims Champagne Ardenne, as president of the jury, examiner
thesis_defense_jury_2: Dr Stéphanie BRICQ, Assistant Professor, University of Burgundy, as examiner
thesis_defense_jury_3: Dr Vincent NOBLET, Research Ingineer, University of Strasbourg, as examiner
thesis_defense_jury_4: Prof Beatriz MARCOTEGUI, Professor, Mines Paristech, as thesis reporter
thesis_defense_jury_5: Prof Camille KURTZ, Professor, University Paris Cité, as thesis reporter

thesis_defense_jury_8: Dr Aurélie LEBORGNE, Assistant Professor, University of Strasbourg, as thesis supervisor, examiner
